---
title: "MBB Ratings - 2026"
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| output: false
library(tidyverse)
library(hoopR)
library(gt)
library(gtExtras)

# Season and shared page helpers (season links, honors, status) -------------
source(here::here('_Helper Files/season.R'))
source(here::here('_Helper Files/Function Scripts/ratings_page.R'))

# Set season
season <- 2026

# Dante header function
gt_dante_title <- readRDS(here::here('_Helper Files/Simulation Functions', 'gt_dante_title.rds'))

# Create Table Function -------------------------
create_ratings_table <- readRDS(here::here('_Helper Files/Other/create_ratings_table.rds'))

# MBB Theme -------------------------
rank_theme <- readRDS(here::here('_Helper Files/Other/rank_theme_mbb.rds'))

# Schedule (honors, status) and standings (W-L) -------------
# Either can be missing early in the season; the page still builds without them.
scoreboard <- dante_try(hoopR::load_mbb_schedule(season))
standings <- dante_try(hoopR::espn_mbb_standings(season))
season_comp_status <- season_finished(scoreboard)

# Load ratings: full season once finished, else in-season (preseason priors until the first daily run)
ratings_file <- pick_ratings_file('vrgl', season, season_comp_status)
have_ratings <- !is.null(ratings_file)

# Load Teams
teams <- readRDS(here::here('_Helper Files/Team Data/team_database.rds'))
conf <- season_conferences('vrgl', season)

team_logos <- dante_try(hoopR::espn_mbb_teams(year = season))
if (is.null(team_logos) || nrow(team_logos) == 0) team_logos <- dante_try(hoopR::espn_mbb_teams(year = season - 1))
if (is.null(team_logos)) team_logos <- tibble(team_id = character(), logo = character())
team_logos <- team_logos %>%
  transmute(team_id = as.character(team_id),
            logo) %>%
  distinct(team_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  full_join(conf, by = 'team_id') %>%
  mutate(logo = case_when(
    is.na(logo) ~ paste0('https://a.espncdn.com/i/teamlogos/ncaa/500/',
                         team_id,
                         '.png'),
    TRUE ~ logo))

## Add logos and conferences to teams
teams <- teams %>%
  left_join(team_logos,
            by = 'team_id') %>%
  filter(team_id != '107554') %>%
  filter(!is.na(conference_short_name))

# Honors: NCAA seed, conference regular-season leader/champion, conference tournament
# champion, national champion. Updates through the season from the schedule.
honors <- season_honors(scoreboard, conf)

# W-L records
records <- season_records(scoreboard, standings, teams$team_id)

if (have_ratings) {
  # Create full ratings table ----------------------------------------------
  ratings_all <- readRDS(ratings_file)
  ratings_tbl <- ratings_stat_table(ratings_all) %>%
    left_join(teams %>%
                select(team_id, team,
                       logo, conference_short_name), by = "team_id") %>%
    filter(!is.na(conference_short_name)) %>%
    left_join(records, by = 'team_id') %>%
    left_join(honors, by = 'team_id') %>%
    mutate(across(c(seed, reg_season, conf_tourn, title), ~ coalesce(.x, ''))) %>%
    arrange(desc(netrtg)) %>%
    mutate(rank = dense_rank(desc(netrtg))) %>%
    select(rank, logo, team, seed,
           reg_season, conf_tourn, title,
           conference_short_name, total,
           pace, oreb_rt, dreb_rt,
           to_rt, to_opp_rt, ast_rt,
           tm_efg, opp_efg,
           ortg, drtg, netrtg)

  # Make table header ------------------
  gt_title <- gt_dante_title(title = glue::glue("{season} VRGL Ratings for Men's Basketball"),
                             subtitle = "Defense-Adjusted Net Team Efficiency (D.A.N.T.E.)",
                             filepath = '',
                             type = "mbb",
                             logo_height = 75)

  # Create table -------------------------
  # (falls back to the plain in-season table if the honors columns ever fail to format)
  table <- dante_try(create_ratings_table(ratings_tbl))
  if (is.null(table)) {
    create_ratings_table_inseason <- readRDS(here::here('_Helper Files/Other/create_ratings_table_inseason.rds'))
    table <- create_ratings_table_inseason(ratings_tbl %>% select(-c(seed, reg_season, conf_tourn, title)))
  }
  table <- table %>% 
    tab_options(table.width = 1000,
                container.width = 1000)

  status_text <- season_status(scoreboard, season, preseason = ratings_are_priors('vrgl', season, ratings_all))
} else {
  table <- ''
  status_text <- glue::glue("Ratings for the {season - 1}-{season - 2000} season will be posted once the preseason ratings are built.")
}

```

`r status_text`

::: {style="text-align: center;"}
`r season_links('vrgl', season)`
:::

`r honors_legend(honors)`

`r table`
